d: Tia and Tamera are caught in the middle when Ray and Lisa square off over Lisa's decision to let the twins "play hooky" from school
When Tia's out sick from school, Tamera befriends a new girl who becomes obsessed with looking and acting like the twins.
Lisa gets "cold feet" after Terrence pops the question, while the twins worry that Lisa's marriage means they'll stop living under the same roof.
Tia rearranges her class schedule in order to spend more time with the school "stud"; Tamera is tapped to pitch a big softball game
Lisa decides it's time to "dump" Terrence and forbids Ray from hanging out with him, while Roger tries to pick which twin to "woo."
When a high school football star needs a tutor, Tamera pretends to be Tia so she can teach him a special lesson in "chemistry"!

t: Sister, Sister: History A La Cart
d: An embarrassing arrest from his college days comes back to haunt Ray, and Lisa turns an inheritance into a shopping spree
When Ray's ne'er-do-well father comes for a visit, he turns the household upside-down -- and turns Tamera into a ruthless businesswoman!
When Tia becomes Tamera's new boss at Rocket Burger, they both learn a lesson in responsibility
While the twins go in search of a Halloween rave, Lisa and Ray attend a fancy party thrown by a prospective client.
Tia and Tamera think they're in for a "free ride" when Ray starts dating their science teacher.

t: Sister, Sister: Thanksgiving in Hawaii (Part I)
d: When Ray and Lisa take the girls to Hawaii for Thanksgiving, they're forced to share their condo with their "exes," who have begun dating each other.

t: Sister, Sister: Thanksgiving in Hawaii (Part II)
d: While Ray and Lisa frantically search for the twins, who are missing in Hawaii, Roger opens the Campbell/Landry home to hobos for Thanksgiving dinner.
The prospect of Tia's attending a prestigious prep school puts social pressure on Tia and financial pressure on Lisa.
When a loan shark comes after Ray's father for a bad debt, the family comes to his rescue.
The twins find themselves in double trouble when they switch identities and Tia winds up with two dates for the same party.
For her film class, Tia "spices up" her family documentary by throwing all sorts of monkey wrenches into their lives.
While volunteering at a local retirement home, Tamera becomes determined to help a grumpy old man find happiness again.
Valentine's Day finds Tamera trying to "steal back" her hot date, and Ray and Lisa wondering if the other person is in love with them.
Tamera crosses the picket lines to work at a supermarket, but soon realizes that being a "scab" isn't all it's cracked up to be.
Ray learns a "noteworthy" lesson in honesty when he "fibs" and tells a tone-deaf Tamera that she plays the piano well, and she winds up humiliating herself at a piano recital.
Tia and Tamera trade places so that Tia can be with a cute guy in summer school and Tamera can "goof off" by taking Tia's spot as a camp counselor.
Tamera learns how much she needs Tia's help when she runs for class president.

t: Sister, Sister: Big Twin on Campus
d: When Tia poses as a college student to impress her older boyfriend, Tamera goes to great lengths to fit in with Tia's new circle of "mature" friends.
Tamera's budding career as a lowdown blues singer is threatened when she gets "too happy" after her dream date asks her out!

t: Sister, Sister: When a Man Loves Two Women
st: When a Man Loves Two Women
d: Unbeknownst to the twins, they've both got a crush on the same guy: Roger!

t: Sister, Sister: You Are So Beautiful
d: Curiosity about their birth parents leads the twins, Ray, and Lisa on a quest to learn more about the girls' past.
Tempted by the freedom of a new car, Tia and Tamera soon find themselves on a collision course with disaster when their car drops off a dock and into Lake Erie!
Tamera learns she's never too old to be a daddy's girl when she finds herself jealous of the growing closeness between Ray and Tia.
In a bid to boost their popularity at school, the twins try out for the cheerleading squad -- and Ray tries his hand at coaching them.
When a new girl in school threatens Tia and Tamera's popularity, the twins join forces to win back their friends with the help of a music superstar.

t: Sister, Sister: Boy From the Hood
d: Tamera falls for Tia's childhood friend Darnell, who's all grown up and running with a fast crowd.
Tia takes a job in a '50s diner to get away from Tamera and is shocked when Tamera starts working there, too.
The twins are thrilled when Ray and Lisa decide to take their relationship to a more romantic level, but have second thoughts when Roger outlines the downsides of their parents dating.
When Tia poses for Tamera's class picture, the gorgeous photo that results makes Tamera extremely popular, and Tia extremely resentful.

t: Sister, Sister: Some Like it Hockey
d: Determined to make the school's all-male hockey team, Tia and Tamera must disguise themselves as boys and pretend they're just two of the guys!
Ray feels left out by the close bond Tamera forms with her new music teacher.
